story: Give the main window an explicit minimum width so a live resize stops at the sidebar plus one tab at their narrowest.
defect: MainWindowController computes window.minSize by adding a static size exposed by its child MainSplitViewController (sidebarMinimumThickness) to one exposed by a great-grandchild, SessionTabViewController.minimumWidth — itself a hand-copied guess of the composer card's narrowest width — so geometry crosses component boundaries and duplicates what the composer's own constraints already decide.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Component boundaries — B1: no geometry crosses a boundary; a component exposes no size for another to read (and B3: nothing reaches past its child)
hit: Says MainWindowController sizes the window from SessionTabViewController.minimumWidth (and the split's sidebar thickness) — a size exposed for another component to read / a far descendant's geometry and a copied composer-width constant instead of letting the constraints decide.
